visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair, round glasses, a white t-shirt, and a dark brown open jacket is walking along a sidewalk lined with large trees in bright daylight. He looks directly at the camera, gesturing with his right hand as he speaks. The background features a green park area and a road with parked cars. (2) An rectangular graphic overlay appears, showing a YouTube thumbnail with two men eating. The man in the jacket points his index finger toward the graphic while maintaining eye contact with the camera and an expressive facial expression. (3) The man stands in front of a building with a 'FOOD COURT' sign and a 7-Eleven logo visible. He uses his fingers to count, holding up his hand in a gesture. The lighting is bright and natural, indicating an outdoor campus environment. (4) The scene shifts to the exterior of 'FJU Food Store.' The man stands next to a large, human-sized plastic soft-serve ice cream cone statue. He gestures towards the store entrance, which has wooden paneling and glass doors. (5) A close-up shot shows a person's hands operating a silver soft-serve machine. Chocolate and vanilla swirled ice cream is being dispensed into a wafer cone held by a hand. The focus is tightly on the movement of the ice cream and the mechanical nozzle. (6) The man walks across a brightly painted yellow and white zebra crossing on a campus road. He turns back to the camera, pointing at a modern grey multi-story building in the distance under a clear sky. (7) A group of three young women in casual student attire (sweatshirts, skirts) join the man. He poses in the center, holding a phone for a selfie and making a 'V' sign with his fingers. They are standing in front of a concrete building with large windows. (8) The man stands alone on the tree-lined path again. He points both index fingers directly at the lens, leaning in slightly with an assertive and playful facial expression as the video concludes.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator, an alumnus of Fu Jen Catholic University, is reacting to a viral video by Joeman and Brian Tseng about National Taiwan University's campus food. He playfully critiques their video and then provides a fast-paced tour of his own alma mater's superior food options (like the famous FJU ice cream) and newly renovated facilities. The ultimate goal is to generate engagement by jokingly challenging the major influencer Joeman to collaborate on a 'Fu Jen School Food' episode.

social_sociology_tags.uniqueSignatures: The creator (Eko) uses his signature fast-talking theatrical delivery, distinctive round glasses, and the context of his affiliation with the 'AmazingTalker Show' channel. The use of variety-show style '引戰' (starting a fight) captions is a common trope in Taiwanese social media culture.
social_sociology_tags.freeDescribe: The video leverages inter-university rivalry and the popularity of established influencers (Joeman, Brian Tseng) to create high-engagement content within the Taiwanese YouTube community.
